metadata.framework: Angular SPA (NgRx state management, no URL routing)
metadata.live_verification_results: 10/10 checks passed. All core states verified against running app at localhost:3022.
metadata.notes: Single-page app — all states live at route '/'. Sub-states use '#qualifier' IDs.

nodes.label: App loading screen with Altair logo and animated dots
nodes.notes: Shown while NgRx store bootstraps; replaced by main IDE once isReady=true

nodes.label: Main GraphQL IDE — URL box, query editor, result pane, side menu
actions: Click 'Set Headers' in side menu [aria-label='Set Headers']
Click 'Request Handlers' in side menu [aria-label='Request Handlers']
Click 'Request Extensions' in side menu [aria-label='Request Extensions']
Click 'Compress Query' in side submenu [aria-label='Compress Query']
Click 'Copy as cURL' in side submenu [aria-label='Copy as cURL']
Click 'Convert to Named Query' in side submenu [aria-label='Convert to Named Query']
Click 'Refactor Query' in side submenu [aria-label='Refactor Query']
Click 'Account' in side menu [aria-label='Account'] (when auth enabled)
Click 'Plugins' in side menu [aria-label='Plugins'] (when experimental enabled)
Click '+' tab to create new window [.window-switcher__item last]
Click settings gear icon in header [.header__actions .header__menu-item:last-child]
Click environment selector in header [.header__menu-item nz-dropdown]
Right-click window tab for context menu
nodes.notes: Web app shows WHATWG disclaimer banner. Sidebar collapses plugin panels.

nodes.label: Query editor pane — Query tab active, CodeMirror editor, variables collapsed
actions: Press keyboard shortcut to send request
nodes.notes: Default tab when a window is opened. CodeMirror with GQL schema hints.

nodes.label: Query editor — Query tab, variables/files panel expanded below editor
actions: Click file variable item to set file [app-variable-file-item]
Drag resize handle to resize variables panel [mwlResizeHandle]
nodes.notes: Variables panel appears below editor when toggled; can include file uploads.

nodes.label: Query editor — Pre-Request tab: script editor with enable toggle
actions: Toggle pre-request script enable checkbox [nz-checkbox preRequestEnabled]
nodes.notes: Tab label has status dot when script is enabled. Uses sandboxed web worker.

nodes.label: Query editor — Post-Request tab: post-request script editor
nodes.notes: Mirror of pre-request tab for post-processing responses.

nodes.label: Query editor — Authorization tab: auth type selector, no auth selected
actions: Select auth type from dropdown [nz-select type]
nodes.notes: Auth types: none, api-key, basic, bearer, oauth2. Tab has status dot when enabled.

nodes.label: Authorization tab — API Key form: key name and value inputs
actions: Select 'Add to' position (Header or Query Param)
nodes.notes: Form appears after selecting 'API Key' from auth type dropdown.

nodes.label: Authorization tab — Basic Auth form: username and password inputs
nodes.notes: Basic auth encodes credentials as Base64 in Authorization header.

nodes.label: Authorization tab — Bearer Token form: token input
nodes.notes: Sets Authorization: Bearer <token> header.

nodes.label: Authorization tab — OAuth2 form: grant type and client credentials
actions: Select OAuth2 grant type (Authorization Code, Auth Code + PKCE, Client Credentials)
nodes.notes: Grant type changes visible fields. Triggers OAuth2 redirect flow.

nodes.label: Result pane — empty state: placeholder art and 'no results' text
actions: Click 'Cancel' button if request is loading [btn--destructive cancelRequestChange]
nodes.notes: Shows tips component (contextual hints). Cancel appears during loading.

nodes.label: Result pane — with response: status code, time, JSON result in CodeMirror
actions: Click plugin UI actions on result if any [uiActionExecuteChange]
nodes.notes: Multiple responses shown as list (for subscriptions). Each has its own download.

nodes.label: Result pane — active subscription: streaming responses, subscription URL shown
nodes.notes: Subscription URL shown. Autoscroll toggle visible when responses > 1.

nodes.label: Result pane — Script Logs tab: timestamped log entries from request scripts
nodes.notes: Tab only visible when requestScriptLogs has entries.

nodes.label: Result pane — Response Headers tab: name/value table of response headers
nodes.notes: Note shown that more headers are visible in desktop/extension apps.

nodes.label: Result pane — bottom panel open (plugin-provided panels below result)
actions: Drag resize handle to resize bottom panel [mwlResizeHandle]
nodes.notes: Plugin-provided bottom panels appear when plugins add panel contributions.

nodes.label: Docs panel hidden — result pane takes full right-side width
actions: Click 'Reload Docs' to load schema and open docs [track-id=reload_docs]
nodes.notes: Default state. Docs button active=false.

nodes.label: Docs panel open — root view: schema types overview, search input
actions: Click on a type to navigate to type view
Click on a field to navigate to field view
Open doc viewer options menu [icon more-horizontal in nav]
Click 'Add to editor' button on a field [DOCS_ADD_QUERY_TEXT]
nodes.notes: Shown when schema has been loaded. Autocomplete suggestions in search.

nodes.label: Docs panel — type detail view: fields, arguments, description for a type
actions: Click breadcrumb link to navigate back
Click a field name to go to field view
Click a linked type to go to another type view
Click 'Add to editor' for a field
nodes.notes: Breadcrumbs show navigation path. Back button shows when history exists.

nodes.label: Docs panel — field detail view: type, arguments, description for a field
nodes.notes: Shows parent type, deprecation notices if any.

nodes.label: Docs panel — directive detail view: directive usage and arguments
nodes.notes: Reached by clicking a directive in docs root.

nodes.label: Docs panel — search results view: filtered fields/types matching query
actions: Click a search result to navigate to type/field view
nodes.notes: Search filters appear when view=search. Autocomplete dropdown on input.

nodes.label: Docs panel — options dropdown: Export SDL, Load Schema options
nodes.notes: Opened from more-horizontal icon in doc viewer navigation.

nodes.label: Request Headers modal: key-value table to set HTTP headers for request
nodes.notes: Modal opened from side menu 'Set Headers' item.

nodes.label: Request Handler modal: transport type, connection params, subscription URL
actions: Select request handler from dropdown [nz-select requestHandlerId]
Edit handler additional params JSON [app-codemirror connectionParamsExtensions]
Toggle 'Use default request handler for subscriptions' [nz-switch]
nodes.notes: Opened from side menu 'Request Handlers'. Configures ws/http transport.

nodes.label: Request History modal: chronological list of past queries
actions: Click a history item to restore it [.history-item click]
nodes.notes: Opened from side menu 'History'. Shows query strings as list items.

nodes.label: Request Extensions modal: JSON editor for request extensions object
actions: Edit extensions JSON in CodeMirror [app-codemirror dataChange]
nodes.notes: Opened from side menu 'Request Extensions'. Sends data in extensions field.

nodes.label: Settings modal — Form view: schema-driven settings form
actions: Click 'Toggle Advanced Mode' link to switch to JSON editor
nodes.notes: Opened from header settings menu. Form mode is default.

nodes.label: Settings modal — Advanced/JSON view: raw JSON settings editor
actions: Edit settings JSON in CodeMirror [app-codemirror settings-editor-textarea]
Click link to 'available settings options' (external docs)
Click 'Toggle Advanced Mode' link to switch back to form view
nodes.notes: Advanced mode shows raw JSON; link to docs.altairgraphql.dev.

nodes.label: Import from cURL modal: textarea for pasting curl command
nodes.notes: Opened from header settings dropdown. Parses curl into new window.

nodes.label: Environment Manager modal — base environment JSON editor
actions: Click a sub-environment to select it
nodes.notes: Base environment always present. Left panel lists environments.

nodes.label: Environment Manager modal — sub-environment selected: titled JSON editor
actions: Select another sub-environment or base env
nodes.notes: Title/export/delete controls appear only for sub-environments.

nodes.label: Plugin Manager modal — list of remote plugins (experimental feature)
actions: Click a plugin in list to select it [.plugin-manager__list-item click]
Click 'Find more plugins on npm' link [external link]
nodes.notes: Only visible when settings.enableExperimental=true. Empty selection = no details.

nodes.label: Plugin Manager modal — plugin selected: name, description, install/remove button
nodes.notes: Shows markdown description. Restart required after install/remove.

nodes.label: Add to Collection modal: name input, collection selector dropdown
actions: Select existing collection from dropdown [nz-select collectionId]
nodes.notes: Opened from URL box 'Save to collection' button.

nodes.label: Add to Collection modal — creating new collection: name + parent + workspace fields
actions: Select workspace (if logged in and no parent) [nz-select workspace]
nodes.notes: Workspace selector only shows when logged in and no parent collection set.

nodes.label: Edit Collection modal — Pre-Request tab: collection pre-request script
nodes.notes: Opened from collection item 'Edit' menu. Default tab is Pre-Request.

nodes.label: Edit Collection modal — Post-Request tab: collection post-request script
nodes.notes: Tab within edit-collection modal.

nodes.label: Edit Collection modal — Environments tab: collection-scoped env variables JSON
nodes.notes: Collection-level env vars override global environments.

nodes.label: Edit Collection modal — Headers tab: collection-level HTTP headers
nodes.notes: Collection headers applied to all queries in the collection.

nodes.label: Account modal — not logged in: login prompt with Google and GitHub buttons
nodes.notes: Only visible when auth is enabled (serverReady && authEnabled).

nodes.label: Account modal — logged in: avatar, welcome, plan stats, billing link
nodes.notes: Shows plan stats: query count, team count, credits. Buy Credits disabled for Pro.

nodes.label: Teams modal — teams list: names, members/edit/delete actions per team
actions: Click team 'Members' icon to view members [icon list]
nodes.notes: Accessed from Account submenu when logged in.

nodes.label: Teams modal — team members view: list of members for selected team
actions: Add a team member (if UI available)
nodes.notes: Shown by clicking members icon on a team row.

nodes.label: Teams modal — Create Team form: team name input with submit
actions: Enter team name in form [formGroup teamForm]
nodes.notes: Shown as nested dialog when Create Team button clicked.

nodes.label: Teams modal — Edit Team form: team name pre-filled for update
nodes.notes: Same form as create-team but with editTeamId set.

nodes.label: Upgrade to Pro modal: pricing, features list, upgrade CTA button
nodes.notes: Shows price per user/interval from API. Only for users with canUpgradePro.

nodes.label: Query Revisions modal: timestamped revision history with restore actions
nodes.notes: Opened from query item context menu in Collections panel.

nodes.label: Collections sidebar panel — open: list of collections with queries
actions: Click a collection to expand/collapse it [query-collections__item-details]
Click a query to open it [query-collections__item-queries-item]
Click side menu 'Collections' to close panel [aria-label=Collections]
nodes.notes: Slides in from left side. Empty state shows prompt text.

nodes.label: Collections sidebar — search active: search input visible, filtered list
actions: Type in search input to filter collections [input placeholder=Search]
Click Search toggle to close search
nodes.notes: Search input toggled by search button; filters collectionTrees.

nodes.label: Window tab context menu: edit name, duplicate, close, reopen options
actions: Click 'Edit Window' to rename tab [icon edit editWindowNameInput]
Click 'Close Windows to the Right' [icon circle]
Click 'Reopen Closed Tab' (if any closed) [icon plus-square]
nodes.notes: Right-click on any window tab. Close options conditional on count/closed list.

nodes.label: Window tab in rename mode: contenteditable tab title input
nodes.notes: Triggered from context menu 'Edit Window' or double-click on tab.

nodes.label: Environments dropdown in header: list of sub-environments, 'Manage Environments'
actions: Click a sub-environment to activate it [nz-menu-item environment.id]
Click 'Environments...' to open Environment Manager [nz-menu-item toggleEnvironmentManager]
nodes.notes: Sub-environments only shown if any exist. Always has 'Environments...' option.

nodes.label: Settings dropdown in header: import/export/settings/GitHub/bug links
actions: Click 'Report Bug' [nz-menu-item external link GitHub issues]
nodes.notes: Opened from gear icon in header right area.

nodes.label: HTTP method dropdown in URL box: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.
actions: Click a method to set it [nz-menu-item method setVerb]
nodes.notes: Defaults to POST. Methods array includes standard HTTP verbs.

nodes.label: Operations dropdown (Send button): select which named operation to run
actions: Click an operation name to select and run it [nz-menu-item operation]
nodes.notes: Only appears when query has >1 named operations.

nodes.label: Collection item context menu: Sync, Edit, Delete, Export collection
actions: Click 'Sync Collection' (if logged in, not already synced) [data-test-id=sync-collection]
nodes.notes: Opened via '...' button on collection item.

nodes.label: Query item context menu: Copy Share URL, Share Public, Revisions, Delete
actions: Click 'Copy Share URL' (if logged in, api storage) [data-test-id=copy-query-share-url]
Click 'Share Public URL' (if logged in, api storage) [data-test-id=share-public-query]
Click 'Show Revisions' (if logged in, api storage) [showQueryRevisionsDialog]
nodes.notes: Opened via '...' button on query item. Cloud features need auth+api storage.

auth_zones.label: Requires Altair Cloud login (auth enabled + logged in)

layouts.label: Main IDE shell: header tabs + side menu + content area
Modal overlay dialogs rendered atop main IDE layout
